question: On six-regular weaves and their role-preserving shuffled twins, how do propagation rounds and untangling phases compare at the sample jump of the forced set, for the two-demand, one-demand and planted not-all-equal laws: does distance force nested open uses?

definitions.patterns: W(L) triangular-torus weave, L = 24..384; R6 = W after 5m degree- and role-preserving knot swaps
definitions.laws: two: atoms (f, y -> x), (f, x -> y) per knot, f uniform; one: one uniformly demanded member per knot; nae: planted state from 30 zero-energy sweeps of the three-class state
definitions.readings: k*, R, P, D (largest steps apart from held to set), avalanche, at k* and k* - 1 and at held fractions 0.05, 0.1, 0.2

public_inputs.code: weaves.py (sha256 9098491b97a7110f9a06c7b5cafebd3b906987740d1e4d3ccabc751f71a245a5); gates.py (sha256 d977d082afa5193590c8af4bc74b4720d7970513f8fd823d5dc8b589847e2f3e); job.py (sha256 ccb0d5fa2711bc0239db4940af6e3038e59859f864cac396c9dff5166b603abe); summarize.py (sha256 2df1afad3947cb2b642d1607222b2bf1dfecde3120be871baf8665b947d7aa6b); atoms.py and job.py of SEQUENTIAL-WALL-20261116-001A-E001; numpy, scipy.
public_inputs.run: scripts/longrun.py launch on job.py; summarize.py RUN

forbidden_inputs: Changing settings, seeds, readings, predictions or decision rules after seeing registered results
primary_observable: Predictions G, T1-T4, O1-O3, N1-N3 of research/SPACE-ORDER-20261117-001/preregistration.md, evaluated by summarize.py.
cheapest_meaningful_control: The role-preserving twin R6 of each weave (same degrees and roles, no steps-apart structure).

predictions.T1: two on W: local slopes of log P*, log R* vs log L >= 0.7 at 96-192 and 192-384; P*/R* at 384 in [0.3, 1]; k*/n at 384 <= half at 48
predictions.O1: one: avalanche at 384 <= 0.05 on W and R6
predictions.N2: nae: P* <= 8 at every size both
predictions.N3: nae W free share in [0.27, 0.31] at L >= 48; 300 sweeps change <= 0.01

decision_rules.each prediction: holds or fails as stated in the pre-registration

stop_rule: One run and its read-out; referee hand-off; report.
runtime: Under an hour on three workers; shared runner.
